Hand-written samples in the published formats of each source (RSS 2.0,
Atom, Google News RSS search, BODACC open-data API v2.1). They are not
captured responses: the build environment cannot reach these hosts.

The two Pappers samples (pappers-recherche.json for /v2/recherche,
pappers-entreprise.json for /v2/entreprise) follow the API v2 field names
and are hand-written the same way.
